body.objective: If the exact two-phase auxiliary-U1 counterflow preflight fails, use its first obstruction to classify the smallest genuinely new action architecture that can alter the trace, health or charge gate, rather than continuing an unstructured coefficient scan.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal counterflow preflight, its full constrained Hessian, characteristic/Jordan data and four-generator charge ledger by exact hashes. If a passing action stratum exists, emit a typed NOT_ACTIVATED disposition and defer to classical-two-phase-counterflow-causal-bv-parent. Otherwise decompose the first failed gate into its invariant obstruction representation and generate a complete bounded comparison of exactly four one-step enlargements: adding the minimal Maxwell kinetic term for the diagonal U1; adding one further positive phase with a complete rank-two integral charge matrix; adding the lowest action-derived dressed curvature/clock coupling that changes the failed scalar constraint while remaining degenerate; and replacing the auxiliary diagonal U1 by the smallest independent Weyl/compact connection gauge structure. For each class derive the stationary equations and the principal constrained scalar/charge block sufficiently to prove whether it can reach the obstruction. Exclude classes structurally when their new Hessian image misses it; for every surviving class solve the smallest exact coefficient locus and run inertia, characteristic and D/K charge preflights. Select at most one next action architecture, or prove the declared four-class enlargement empty. Land exact ansatz dimensions, image/rank or separating witnesses, independent verification, mutations, receipt and an atlas/roadmap disposition.
body.current_gate: obstruction-driven minimal changed architecture after a two-phase counterflow no-go
body.forbid: no activation when the counterflow preflight passes; no arbitrary higher polynomial P(X); no adding more phases without a complete charge-rank theorem; no Maxwell or geometric field without its action, gauge/BV typing and principal block; no sampled coefficient fitting; no causal, q2, Einstein, anomaly, Hadamard, particle or unitarity promotion from this preflight
activates: one selected minimal changed action, only if its exact stationary/health/charge preflight passes
body.resource_hint: NO-GO-BRANCH CLASSICAL CLASSIFICATION. Let the exact obstruction determine which new action images are relevant. Conflux may enumerate invariant candidates only after the obstruction representation and complete bounded four-class ansatz are typed; acceptance remains exact action-derived substitution and independent replay.
